design_philosophy: Maximize profitability through diverse strategy candidates and rigorous parameter optimization

agents.responsibility: Identify profitable market patterns: mean reversion regimes, volatility clusters, momentum breaks. Analyze BTCUSDT, SPY, QQQ for profitability markers. Produce pattern JSON with win rates where possible.
agents.enhanced_focus: Find patterns with >52% win rate and positive expectancy

agents.responsibility: Define mandate, asset universe (BTCUSDT, SPY, QQQ, etc), capital allocation, and profitability targets: min Sharpe 1.5, min return 15% annual, max drawdown 0.15.
agents.enhanced_focus: Select 2-3 assets with distinct volatility profiles for strategy diversification

agents.responsibility: Design multiple strategy candidates: (1) Mean Reversion with Bollinger Bands & RSI, (2) Momentum with MACD & ADX, (3) Volatility-Based with Keltner Channels, (4) ML-based momentum with lagged returns. Define entry/exit rules, position sizing, stop-loss levels for each.
agents.enhanced_focus: Provide 3-4 distinct strategy archetypes with clear implementation guides

agents.responsibility: Implement all strategy signals from Strategy Engineer: compute technical indicators (RSI, Bollinger Bands, MACD, ADX, Keltner), combine into entry/exit logic with position sizing. Produce production-ready signal code.
agents.enhanced_focus: Generate 3-4 parallel signal implementations ready for backtesting

agents.responsibility: Grid-search optimal parameters for each strategy across BTCUSDT/SPY/QQQ. Test RSI thresholds (20-80), Bollinger Band widths (1.5-3.0), MACD windows (6-26 fast, 17-35 slow), hold periods (1-5 days). Report best parameters with backtest metrics.
agents.enhanced_focus: Run 50-100 backtest combinations, identify top 3 parameter sets by Sharpe ratio

agents.responsibility: Execute out-of-sample backtest for each strategy candidate (mean reversion, momentum, volatility, ML). Report Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, annual return, win rate, recovery factor for each. Rank by Sharpe ratio. Recommend top 2 strategies.
agents.enhanced_focus: Comparative analysis across 3+ strategies, select only those meeting profitability targets

agents.responsibility: Review all backtest results from Strategy Validator. Select best strategy by Sharpe + return metrics. For multi-asset: recommend allocation to top 2 strategies across different assets if diversification improves outcomes. Produce final decision with justification.
agents.enhanced_focus: Make go-no-go decision: APPROVED if Sharpe >1.5 and annual return >5%, REVISE if not

agent_team_notes.v1_issues: Simple moving average strategy too naive; no parameter optimization; single signal architecture
agent_team_notes.v2_improvements: Multiple strategy archetypes; parameter grid search; signal diversification; multi-asset support; explicit profitability thresholds
agent_team_notes.removal_rationale: Legacy Quant Architect merged into Strategy Engineer for better output structure; Algo Developer split into Signal Designer + Parameter Optimizer for specialization
